info.title: TerraScale Auth platform API
info.description:
Contract v1 of the platform identity API (TS-598, epic TS-597): organizations, projects, members, roles,
invitations, ownership transfer, audit events and API keys of the `terrascale` tenant, and the token
endpoint grants that turn API keys and user sign-ins into organization and project tokens.
docs/platform-contract.md is the prose half of this contract. Operations are served as their slices land;
the served /openapi/v1.json describes what is served.

tags.name: Organizations
tags.description: Organizations of the terrascale tenant. The caller is a signed-in platform user.

tags.name: Members
tags.description: Organization members and their organization roles (viewer, member, admin, owner).

tags.name: Invitations
tags.description: Email invitations to an organization role or to one project's role.

tags.name: Ownership transfer
tags.description: Handing an organization's ownership to another member, confirmed by the nominee.

tags.name: Projects
tags.description: Projects of an organization. Each project is also the tenant of its end users.

tags.name: Project members
tags.description: Explicit project roles (viewer, member, admin), for organization members and collaborators.

tags.name: API keys
tags.description: Client credentials owned by an organization or project, exchanged at the token endpoint for short-lived tokens.

tags.name: Audit
tags.description: Audit events of an organization's identity changes.

tags.name: OAuth
tags.description: Token endpoint grants for API keys (client credentials) and user organization or project tokens (token exchange).

post.description: The caller becomes its first member, with the owner role.

get.description: Organizations the caller is a member of, and those where it is a collaborator on a project (role null), in id order.
Members and collaborators. A caller who is neither gets 404, as for an unknown id.

delete.description: Needs the owner role. 409 not_empty while it has projects. Deletes its members, invitations, transfer, organization API keys and audit events.

get.description: Needs any organization role. In user id order.

put.description: Needs admin, and owner when the member is or becomes an owner. 409 last_owner when it would demote the last owner.

delete.description: Needs admin, and owner to remove an owner. 409 last_owner for the last owner. Also removes the user's project roles in the organization.

post.description: Members and collaborators. Removes the caller's organization and project roles. 409 last_owner for the last owner.

Without project_id: an organization role; needs admin, and owner to invite an owner. With project_id: a role
on that project; needs the project's admin role. ts-auth emails a link to TS_AUTH_INVITATION_URL?token=…;
the token is also answered once. Valid 7 days, single use. 409 invitation_pending while an unexpired
invitation for the email and target is pending, 409 already_member when the address's user already has it.

201.description: The invitation and its token, shown once.

get.description: Every invitation with its status, in creation order. Needs admin; a project admin lists its project's with project_id.

delete.description: Needs admin, or the project's admin for a project invitation. Its status becomes revoked and its token stops working. 409 when it is no longer pending.

post.summary: Look up an invitation by token
post.description: Any signed-in user holding the token. A token that is unknown, expired or no longer pending answers 404.

The caller's token must carry email_verified true and an email equal to the invitation's, ignoring case
(403 otherwise). 404 for an unknown token, 409 invitation_expired, 409 when it is no longer pending or the
user already has the role.
Same email rule as accept. The invitation's status becomes declined.
Needs owner. The nominee is a member who is not an owner. Replaces a pending transfer; valid 7 days.

get.description: Needs any organization role. 404 when there is none.

post.description: Only the nominee. The nominee becomes an owner and the owner who started it an admin.
Needs the member organization role. Creates the project's tenant; the caller becomes the project's explicit admin. 409 name_taken.

get.description: Every project for organization members, the granted ones for collaborators; in id order.
Needs an effective project role. Others get 404.

patch.description: Needs the project's admin role. 409 name_taken.

delete.description:
Needs the project's admin role. Deletes its tenant, project roles, pending invitations and API keys; no
token is issued for it afterwards. TerraBase databases are not deleted: the platform deletes them first.

get.description: Needs an effective project role. Lists explicit grants only; organization members' implied roles are not repeated. In user id order.

put.summary: Grant or change a project role
put.description: Needs the project's admin role. A new grant needs a member of the organization (404 otherwise; invite anyone else).

delete.description: Needs the project's admin role. A collaborator left with no project role leaves the organization.

post.description: Needs admin. The key reaches every project of the organization, one project per token. The key string is answered once.

201.description: The key and its secret string, shown once.

get.description: Needs admin. Unrevoked keys, never secrets, in creation order.

delete.description: Needs admin. No token is issued for it afterwards; tokens already issued expire within 15 minutes.

post.description: Needs admin. Issues a new secret for the same id; the previous one keeps working for previous_secret_ttl seconds.

200.description: The key and its new secret string, shown once.

post.description: Needs the project's member role; scopes must be within the caller's. The key string is answered once.

201.description: The key and its secret string, shown once.

get.description: Needs the project's member role. Unrevoked keys, never secrets, in creation order.

delete.description: Needs the project's member role. No token is issued for it afterwards; tokens already issued expire within 15 minutes.

post.description: Needs the project's member role. Issues a new secret for the same id; the previous one keeps working for previous_secret_ttl seconds.

200.description: The key and its new secret string, shown once.

get.description: Needs admin. Newest first; kept at least 90 days.

apiKey.summary: An organization API key, for a project token

user.summary: A user's sign-in token, for a project token

200.description: An organization or project access token.

400.description: invalid_request, unsupported_grant_type, unauthorized_client, invalid_grant, invalid_scope or invalid_target.

401.description: invalid_client; unknown, wrong, revoked and expired keys answer alike.

platformUser.description:
A sign-in access token of the terrascale tenant (typ at+jwt, aud including the issuer). Organization,
project, API key and service tokens are refused.

clientBasic.description: OAuth client authentication; for an API key, the key id and the whole key string.

Project.name: project
Project.description: Project id, also its tenant slug.

User.name: user
User.description: User id (the sub of its tokens).

BadRequest.description: invalid_request, or name_taken-style input errors listed on the operation.

Unauthorized.description: unauthorized; no valid platform sign-in token.

NotFound.description: not_found; also for anything the caller cannot see.

Conflict.description: name_taken, not_empty, last_owner, already_member, invitation_pending, invitation_expired or not_pending.

Unavailable.description: temporarily_unavailable; storage could not complete the request.

Name.description: Trimmed; contains a letter or digit and no control characters.

role.description: The caller's organization role; null for a collaborator.

issuer.description: The project tenant's issuer, {public origin}/{project id}.

role.description: An organization role without project_id, a project role with it.

token.description: Shown once; also emailed to the invitee.

database.description: A TerraBase database name; the key then reaches only that database.

previous_secret_ttl.description: Seconds the previous secret keeps working.

previous_secret_expires_at.description: Until when the secret before the last rotation still works; null when it no longer does.

key.description: The whole key string, shown once. Its leading 26-character ULID is the entity and OAuth client id.

target.description: A user id, email, project id or key id.

detail.description: The new role, name or scopes.

ClientCredentialsGrant.description: An API key exchanged for an organization or project token.

project.description: Organization keys, the project to act in (omit for an organization token); project keys, optional and equal to the key's.

scope.description: Space-separated subset of the key's scopes; default all of them.

client_secret.description: With client_secret_post, the whole key string.

TokenExchangeGrant.description: A user's sign-in access token exchanged for an organization or project token (RFC 8693).

subject_token.description: A sign-in access token of this tenant, issued to the same client.

scope.description: Space-separated subset of what the user's role allows; default all of it.

client_id.description: A public client, or a confidential one with client_secret_post.
